Event-stream dependency compromised Copay wallet

Target: Copay
Repository: https://github.com/bitpay/copay
Date: 2018-09-09 to 2018-11-26 (78 days)
Attribution: Individual hacker
Component: Application
Language: JavaScript
Cause: Compromised dependency
Motive: Financial gain
Transitive: true
Impact Type: Cryptocurrency theft
User Impact: 1000000
Domain: copay.io (project download host)

Synopsis

The Copay Bitcoin wallet was affected by the malicious event-stream NPM package. The backdoor specifically targeted Copay to steal Bitcoin from users' wallets.
